summary: Provisioned a 1 GiB LUKS1-encrypted XFS volume at /srv/secure. It unlocks and mounts automatically at boot using RHEL 7-compatible cryptsetup 2.0.3. The OS remains RHEL 7.9 with kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64. Persistence was proven through a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed signature-verified cryptsetup 2.0.3 compatible with the existing RHEL 7 libraries.
Generated the encryption key locally on node1 with root-only permissions.
Created a LUKS1 container, dm-crypt mapping, XFS filesystem, and /srv/secure mount.
Configured /etc/crypttab and /etc/fstab for unattended boot activation.
Verified declarative unlock/mount from an inactive state.
Safely rebooted node1 exactly once and verified automatic recovery and preserved data.

evidence.summary: Shows the LUKS1 header, protected key and container permissions, active AES-XTS mapping, XFS mount, and readable persistence marker.

evidence.requirement: Automatic unlock and mount at boot
evidence.summary: Shows crypttab/fstab-generated units, successful declarative reactivation, and active automatic mapping/mount after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use legacy-compatible software
evidence.summary: Confirms RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160 before and after, with cryptsetup 2.0.3 and LUKS1 on the existing dm-crypt kernel module.
Captures healthy pre-restart state and boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered LUKS mapping, XFS mount, services, and marker data.
